headline: TOPA Spider found strong restricted analogues (beta-acyclic DP elimination, bounded-width local consistency, bounded-treewidth dynamic programming, backdoors) and strong barriers (proof automatization, PLS/local-search path length, simplex pivot lower bounds, compression limits), but no universal polynomial route law for arbitrary CNF.
scientific_boundary: No P=NP claim. Restricted tractability/FPT results are not universal SAT algorithms. P vs NP remains open.
